sources.observation: A separate Lunar Lake user reports intermittent multi-model device loss on driver 5540. Later tests invalidate the initial claim that turbo, disabling pruning, or keepalive prevent all failures. This is a hypothesis source, not a root-cause identification or fix for Panther Lake.
The reviewed Intel download page still lists 32.0.100.5540, matching the installed NPU driver.
The October 12 update remains validated on Meteor Lake/NPU3720; it does not establish Panther Lake custom-kernel compatibility.
